description: Applies to one job by job_match_id or job_url, on the employer's own hiring system. mode "auto" submits, "review" holds for approval, and no mode follows the account setting. A sent application cannot be withdrawn. When GetMattered cannot apply, nothing is sent and the answer says why.

job_match_id.description: The job_match_id of a match from getmattered_get_matches (e.g. 48213). Either this or job_url.

job_url.description: Link to any job posting to apply to. Either this or job_match_id, which identifies a job from getmattered_get_matches.

mode.description: "auto" submits with no review step. "review" holds the prepared application for the user's approval. Left out, the user's account setting decides. Applies to this application only.

name: getmattered_apply

alreadyExisted.description: True when this job already had an application, which is returned instead of a second one.

applicationId.description: The application to follow with getmattered_get_applications. Null only when nothing was started.

employerConfirmed.description: True ONLY when the employer sent a receipt or showed its confirmation page. Never true right after an apply.

host.description: The host of the job_url, when one was given.

notice.description: Set when the confirmation form got no answer: the application is held for approval and nothing was sent. Tell the user once.

outcome.description: started: a new application; already_in_progress: this job already had one (alreadyExisted); not_confirmed: the user declined, nothing was sent; not_applied: nothing was sent, see reason and userAction.

reason.description: Null when a new application started. unsupported_host: GetMattered does not submit on that hiring system, and nothing was saved. posting_not_found: the employer has no posting at that link. import_failed: the posting could not be read or saved. already_applied: this job already has an application. Do not retry with other URLs for the same job.

reasonDetail.description: Why the posting could not be read, ready to tell the user. Set only with import_failed.

setupStep.description: Set while account setup is open: the step to take first.

status.description: Our own record. Never proof the employer received it.

userAction.description: What the user can do next, ready to tell them. Null when a new application started.

title: Apply to Job
